title: Average of Numbers
description: The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 27. What is the largest number?
explanation: If average is 27, middle number is 27. For 5 consecutive odd numbers: 23, 25, 27, 29, 31. Largest is 31.

title: Percentage Calculation
description: A shopkeeper marks his goods 40% above cost price but allows a discount of 20%. What is his profit percentage?
explanation: Let CP = 100. Marked Price = 140. After 20% discount: 140 × 0.8 = 112. Profit = 12%.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description: Find the contiguous subarray which has the largest sum and return its sum.
explanation: Kadane's Algorithm is optimal with O(n) time and O(1) space complexity.

title: Compound Interest
description: Find the compound interest on Rs. 5000 at 10% p.a. for 2 years compounded annually.

title: Time and Work
description: A can do a work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they work together for 4 days, what fraction of work is left?
explanation: A's 1 day work = 1/15, B's 1 day work = 1/20. Together = 1/15 + 1/20 = 7/60. In 4 days = 4 × 7/60 = 7/15. Remaining = 1 - 7/15 = 8/15

title: Ratio and Proportion
description: If A:B = 2:3 and B:C = 4:5, find A:B:C
explanation: Make B equal: A:B = 2:3 = 8:12 and B:C = 4:5 = 12:15. Therefore A:B:C = 8:12:15

title: Speed and Distance
description: A train 100m long running at 36 km/hr crosses a platform in 20 seconds. What is the length of the platform?
explanation: Speed = 36 km/hr = 10 m/s. Distance = 10 × 20 = 200m. Platform length = 200 - 100 = 100m

title: Profit and Loss
description: By selling an article for Rs. 240, a man loses 20%. For what price should he sell it to gain 20%?
explanation: SP = 240 at 20% loss means CP = 240/0.8 = 300. For 20% profit: SP = 300 × 1.2 = 360

title: Simple Interest
description: At what rate percent per annum will Rs. 8000 amount to Rs. 10000 in 4 years at simple interest?

title: Mixture and Alligation
description: In what ratio must water be mixed with milk costing Rs. 12 per liter to get a mixture worth Rs. 8 per liter?
explanation: By alligation: (12 - 8):(8 - 0) = 4:8 = 1:2. Water must be mixed in ratio 1:2
